_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

agreement.claim: both engines report the same adjusted effect, standard error, interval and baseline coefficient
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0 at ten significant digits on every key. harness/regression_examples.test.py checks the fit against a least-squares solve and shows the follow-up-only and change-score standard errors (0.86 and 0.71) exceed ANCOVA's (0.61).

recovery.claim: the adjusted effect and baseline coefficient are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: At 100 per arm the effect's miss (1.98) left little room below the effect of 3; the fixture uses 200 per arm.
